name: Normal assignment, many candidates
expected_behavior: Multiple qualified, available SMEs exist; agent ranks and selects the highest-scoring one.

name: Qualified SME busy, runner-up available
expected_behavior: Busy top candidate excluded by the hard calendar-conflict rule; next eligible candidate recommended.

name: Qualified SME busy, runner-up available
expected_behavior: Busy top candidate excluded by the hard calendar-conflict rule; next eligible candidate recommended.

name: No qualified SME
expected_behavior: No active SME holds Advanced Cloud Computing; session is UNFILLED with a Critical, no-qualified-SME exception.

name: Qualified but unavailable
expected_behavior: Every qualified Career Coaching SME has a calendar conflict at this time; session is UNFILLED with a Critical, qualified-but-unavailable exception.

name: Expertise vs. workload tradeoff
expected_behavior: SME004 scores highest on expertise/performance but carries a heavy rolling workload; SME005 is close behind with a much lighter workload. Fairness narrows the gap without automatically winning.

name: Exact scoring tie
expected_behavior: SME001 and SME002 are identical on expertise, performance, fairness and preference; deterministic tie-break order resolves it.

name: Cross-timezone hard exclusion
expected_behavior: SME008 would be qualified, but the session falls outside working hours in their local timezone; hard-excluded.

name: Free but outside preferred hours
expected_behavior: SME008 is technically available (within working hours) but the session falls outside their stated preference window; preference score reduced, not excluded.

name: Daily capacity reached
expected_behavior: SME006 has max_sessions_per_day=1 and is already assigned S009 earlier that day; excluded from S010 by the hard capacity rule.

name: Offline location mismatch
expected_behavior: SME007 is the only qualified SME but is based in Bangalore while the session is Offline in Singapore; hard-excluded on location.

name: Original SME declines, replacement accepts
expected_behavior: Approve the AI recommendation, simulate an RSVP decline, confirm a replacement is recommended and can be invited and accepted.

name: Decline with no available replacement
expected_behavior: SME009 is the sole qualified+available Career Coaching SME; simulating a decline leaves zero replacement candidates, producing a Critical unfilled exception.
